item.title: RoboOmp: An AI Bot That Creates Its Own Pull Requests
item.description: Yesterday at the Oh My Pi (OMP) repository, I experienced something shocking: an AI bot didn’t just reply to my issue—it understood the problem, dug through the source code on its own, and opened a precise PR to fix the bug. The entire process took less than 5 minutes.

item.title: sth: An HTML Preview Server for AI Agents
item.description:
I’ve open sourced a small tool: static-html, with the command-line name sth.

What it does is simple: it provides an HTTP service that lets you register locally generated HTML files and preview them in a browser.
